createWorld.customize.maze_world.title: Maze World Customization
maze_type.binary_tree.name: Binary Tree
maze_type.binary_tree.description:
A very simple algorithm with a bias to make diagonal corridors
The threshold controls the ratio of horizontal and vertical corridors.
maze_type.wang_tiles.name: Wang Tiles
maze_type.wang_tiles.description:
Makes a maze by filling in matching random tiles. This can generate corridors not connected to anything.
The threshold controls the ratio of the wall and corridor width.
maze_type.round_wang_tiles.name: Round Wang Tiles
maze_type.round_wang_tiles.description:
Makes a rounded off maze by filling in matching random tiles. This can generate corridors not connected to anything.
The threshold controls the ratio of the wall and corridor width.
maze_type.simplex_noise.name: Simplex noise
maze_type.simplex_noise.description: Makes a maze by comparing a 2D noise map by the set threshold value.
maze_type.simplex_noise_3d.name: Simplex noise 3D
maze_type.simplex_noise_3d.description: Makes a maze by comparing a 3D noise map by the set threshold value. This generates bedrock caves through the whole world.

createWorld.customize.maze_world.structu: The maze walls may replace all structures. This may make it impossible to open the end portal.
Prevents maze walls from cutting through the end portal room in the stronghold.
Prevents maze walls from cutting through any bounding box of a structure piece.
createWorld.customize.maze_world.infinit: Prevents the player from going above or below the walls in worlds without a ceiling by rejecting movement packets that cross the maze walls
